title: InvariantReview
description: Structured verdict on whether a freshly-rebased patch stack still preserves the fork's invariants. Consumed by the CI publish gate. Produced by the FORK opencode binary via `--output-schema` (dogfooding feature #9320).

invariants.description: One entry per invariant in prompts/resolve-conflict.md (#1 encode-as-Struct, #2 retryCount, #3 permission-exempt tool, #4 --output-schema CLI).

redundant_patches.description: Invariant ids upstream has now implemented itself, so our patch for them can be dropped.

summary.description: One-paragraph rationale; becomes the ntfy body if escalation is needed.
